property_summary: The reference C never mutates any state in setL1BlockValues (l1FeeOverhead() stays 0 for every input), whereas the mutant stores the passed _l1FeeOverhead, making c.l1FeeOverhead() equal that input after a call.
change_summary: Insert an assignment storing the passed _l1FeeOverhead into the state variable l1FeeOverhead after the require check, so the value becomes observable via the public l1FeeOverhead() getter.
